function.name: handoff
function.description: Hand one piece of work to a team mate. The postman opens a task (t-NNNN) and sends it; you get mail when it is done, blocked or failed.

workflow.description: Workflow entry file to follow, or "無" if none

goal.description: One sentence: what done looks like

done_when.description: After DONE: file_exists{path}, table_filled{path}, check{name,args} (contains/not_contains{path,text}, wf_residue, wf_lint_strict), cmd_ok{run}, judge{text} (reviewer)

function.name: board
function.description: Read the team task board. op=ls lists open tasks (all=true includes finished); op=show shows one task.

function.name: review_result
function.description: Answer a review task: one item per listed point, each with pass and a one-line why.

function.name: ask_human
function.description: Ask the user something only they can decide. The answer arrives later as new mail; end your turn after asking.

function.name: compact_me
function.description: Shrink your own memory: old rounds become a short summary after this turn ends.

keep_rounds.description: Recent rounds kept word for word

function.name: lock
function.description: Short-term exclusive lock on a file or folder name, for teammates sharing a project. acquire fails fast if busy; ls/acquire/release results arrive as new mail.

ttl_seconds.description: Auto-release after this long if not released (default 1800)

function.name: access_request
function.description: Ask the user to mount one more folder for you (folders only, not networking). You cannot edit access.json yourself; the answer arrives as new mail.

function.name: persona_propose
function.description: Propose adding one sentence to your own persona. You cannot edit it yourself; the user's answer arrives as new mail.

function.name: routine_propose
function.description: Propose a recurring heartbeat routine (every/daily/once). Opens a question for the user to approve; only runs after they say yes.

function.name: spawn_member
function.description: Ask the user to add a new team mate from a built-in template (flat roster, talks only via the postman). The answer arrives as new mail.

mail_to.description: Who it may mail (default: you and human)

function.name: tool_draft
function.description: Draft a new Python tool for yourself. code must define main(args, root) (root = work dir) returning text; args arrive already checked against parameters. It is tested in a sandbox: failures come back as mail, a pass waits for the user to install it.

parameters.description: JSON Schema object of the arguments

cases.description: 1-5 examples, at least one expect "ok": {args, expect: "ok" or error code, contains?, files?: {path: text}}
